title: Go and Rust review packs v1

output.summary: Approve Go and Rust language review packs using owned low-level tool adapters.

approvedRows.question: Should CodeWiki add Go and Rust review packs for implementation evidence?
approvedRows.currentState: CodeWiki has common review plus TS/JS and Python packs, but Go and Rust projects have only common evidence.
approvedRows.desiredState: Add Go test/vet and Rust cargo test/clippy packs that detect tools, run shell-free under budgets, parse diagnostics, and emit normalized implementation evidence.
approvedRows.rationale: CodeWiki must support multi-language projects with owned adapters while keeping external tools as evidence sensors only.
approvedRows.userImpact: Go and Rust users get first-class test/lint/type-style evidence in Implementation review.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers must keep commands optional, deterministic, shell-free, and covered by parser tests.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Needs adapter source, config defaults, tests, docs, and verification.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Extends the established language-pack architecture without new dependencies.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: User explicitly requested both Go and Rust packs.
agentAssessment.rationale: Commands are sensors; CodeWiki remains semantic authority.

approvedRows.currentPain: Go/Rust code changes lack language-specific review evidence.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: Go and Rust packs run and normalize diagnostics when configured tools exist.
approvedRows.successSignal: Tests prove detection, parsing, injected runs, config defaults, and exit-review blocking diagnostics.
nonGoals: Do not install Go, Rust, Clippy, or Cargo components.
Do not make external tools semantic authority.

currentStatePacket.summary: TS/JS and Python review packs exist; Go/Rust packs missing.
